title: Discover
subtitle: Upcoming films and series from your metadata providers, and what UltraTorrent decided about each one.

actions.syncDone: Catalogue refreshed — {{examined}} title(s) re-evaluated, {{monitored}} now monitored
actions.syncRetracted: {{count}} title(s) no longer match and are no longer monitored; {{removed}} left the catalogue. Downloaded media was not touched.

firstRun.title: No discovery provider is enabled yet
firstRun.body: Discovery makes no third-party calls until you enable a provider. Once enabled, catalogues refresh in the background and appear here. Nothing is monitored automatically until you also create and enable a discovery template.

providers.title: Providers
providers.noneDescription: Discovery ships with TMDB and TVmaze. TMDB needs an API key; TVmaze needs none.
providers.explainer: A provider is silent until you enable it — nothing is fetched from a third party before that. Enabling one only refreshes catalogues; it does not monitor or download anything.

inbox.emptyDescription: Enable a provider and refresh the catalogues, or widen the filters above.

autoMonitorCategories.title: Monitor automatically
autoMonitorCategories.help: Titles in these categories get a watchlist entry and an acquisition rule without being asked.

notifyOnlyCategories.title: Tell me only
notifyOnlyCategories.help: Surfaced in the inbox. Nothing is created until you act on it.

ignoreCategories.title: Hide
ignoreCategories.help: Filed away so the same unwanted title stops reappearing.

blockedFromAutoCategories.title: Never automatically
blockedFromAutoCategories.help: Beats every list above. A Sci-Fi title that is also a Documentary will not auto-monitor if Documentary is here — it is still shown, just never added on its own.

policy.contradiction: These categories are both monitored and hidden, which cannot both be true: {{list}}

form.name: Name
form.releaseTypesAll: No selection means every release type counts.
form.pathHelp: Tokens: {tvshow} {movie} {year} {season_number}. The root comes from the storage profile.
form.notifyOnlyNotice: This template has no auto-monitor categories, so it only notifies. A feed and storage profile are not needed.

preview.heading: If this template ran now, over {{examined}} discovered titles:
preview.beyondAllowance: {{count}} of these would be held for review — your weekly limit is {{perWeek}}.
preview.truncated: The catalogue is larger than one preview reads, so these are a sample rather than a total.

templates.emptyDescription: A template decides which discovered titles are monitored automatically. Nothing is monitored until you create one and enable it.
templates.explainer: A template is a standing instruction. While one is enabled, matching titles get a watchlist entry and an acquisition rule without being asked.
templates.limits: Up to {{perDay}} per day, {{perWeek}} per week
templates.confirmDelete: Delete the template "{{name}}"? Titles it already monitored are not affected.

remove.title: Remove “{{title}}”
remove.planError: Could not work out what removing this would affect.

catalog.label: From the catalogue only
catalog.detail: 1 discovered title and {{evaluations}} evaluation(s). Monitoring is left running.

library.label: …and delete the library media
library.sidecars: Artwork, subtitles and NFO sidecars go with them
library.unidentified: This title carries no external id, so its media cannot be identified with certainty — files will not be touched.

remove.alsoTorrent: Also remove the torrent and its data
remove.trashNote: Files are moved to Trash by the same path-safe service the File Manager uses, not deleted outright.
remove.userRuleKept: The rule “{{name}}” was edited by hand and will be left in place.
remove.suppressNote: This title will not come back on the next catalogue refresh. You can undo that from the suppressions list.
